title: Memory District
framing: A curated timeline of research-led reconstructions, not a geographic reconstruction of Singapore.

entries.name: Tank Road Railway Station
entries.removed: After closure in 1932; exact demolition date not established
entries.location: Tank Road and River Valley Road, below Fort Canning
entries.story: Singapore's principal passenger terminus before Tanjong Pagar, linking the town to Kranji, Johor and Malaya during the first decades of island railway travel.
